tex_content.html:
Definition

A tuple $(E_1,\ldots ,E_k)$ of vector fields on $A\subseteq \mathbb {R}^n$ is orthonormal if $(E_1|_p,\ldots ,E_k|_p)$ is orthonormal for the Euclidean inner product at every $p\in A$. An orthonormal frame is a frame consisting of orthonormal vector fields.
